prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Top Thrill 2** at Cedar Point in Sandusky, Ohio. It briefly became the world’s tallest operating steel coaster after Kingda Ka closed, but lost that title when **Falcon’s Flight** opened at Six Flags Qiddiya in Saudi Arabia on December 31, 2025.
